definitions.gloss: cutting corners; sloppy work; half-hearted effort
definitions.explanation: Deliberately doing less work than required or skipping steps to save time or effort, often resulting in lower quality.

examples.japanese: {手抜|てぬ}き⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になった。
examples.english: Shoddy construction work became a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手抜|てぬ}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I cut corners on the cleaning.

examples.japanese: {手抜|てぬ}き⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しく→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Even easy-prep meals can turn out delicious.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧ (omitting, skipping) - literally removing hands from the work.

USAGE:
Can be:
- Negative: implying sloppy or irresponsible work
- Neutral/positive: when referring to efficient shortcuts ({手抜|てぬ}き⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ = easy recipes)

COMPOUNDS:
- {手抜|てぬ}き⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ - shoddy construction
- {手抜|てぬ}き⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ - easy-prep cooking

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手抜|てぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to cut corners
- {手抜|てぬ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧ - corner-cutting is discovered
